tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅/ /bla ma mgon po dbyer med kyi sgrub thabs bzhugs so// bla ma dang mgon po dbyer med la phyag 'tshal lo/ /myur mdzad spyan ras gzigs la phyag 'tshal lo/ /'dir nyin khu'i yan lag tu bla ma khyung po man gyis sbyar ba'i bla ma mgon po dbyer med kyi nyams len la/ dpal mgon 'di'i byin rlabs thob pa'i rnal 'byor pas/ gnas dben par/ skyabs 'gro sems bskyed sngon du btang nas/ rang gi spyi bor paṃ las sna tshogs pad+ma 'dab ma brgyad pa'i lte bar/ a las zla ba'i dkyil 'khor gyis steng du/ hūm̐ sna tshogs las sna tshogs rdo rje'i lte bar/ hūm̐ sna tshogs kyis mtshan pa/ de las 'od zer 'phros pas 'phags pa mchod sems can gyi sdig sgrib sbyang / tshur 'dus yongs su gyur pa las/ bcom ldan 'das rdo rje sems dpa' sku mdog sna tshogs pa/ zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa/ g.yas sna tshogs rdo rje dang / g.yon de'i yu ba byas pa'i dril bu 'dzin pas yum la 'khyud pa/ de'i pang na yum rdo rje snyems ma sku mdog sna tshogs ma zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa/ g.yas gri gug dang g.yon thod khrag 'dzin pas yab la 'khyud pa/gnyis ka'ang rus pa dang rin po ches brgyan pa'i dpral bar oṃ dkar po/ mgrin par āḥdamar po/ thugs kar hūm̐ sngon po/ lte bar hūm̐ sna tshogs/ de las 'od 'phros pas/ bla ma yi dam sangs rgyas thams cad rdo rje sems dpa'i rnam par spyan drangs/ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ ho gnyis su med par bstim/ bcom ldan 'das bdag gis tshe thog ma med pa nas bsags pa'i sdig sgrib nyes ltung dri ma'i tshogs thams cad byang zhing dag par byin gyis brlab tu gsol/ zhes gsol ba btab pas/ thugs ka'i hūm̐ las bdud rtsi kha dog lnga pa byung nas yab yum gnyis ka'i sku gang / de gnyis kyi sbyor mtshams nas bdud rtsi byung nas spyi bo'i tshangs bug nas byon pas sdig sgrib thams cad dud khu'i rnam par 'og sgo gnyis dang rkang mthil gnyis nas thon par bsam zhing /

ngag tu yi ge brgya pa bzlas mjug tu/ bdag ni mi shes rmongs pas ste/ zhes sogs brjod la/ rdo rje sems dpa' bdag la thim pas/ rang rdo rje sems dpa' sku mdog sna tshogs pa/ phyag g.yas sna tshogs rdo rje thugs kar gtod de 'dzin pa/ g.yon de'i yu ba byas pa'i dril bu dkur bsten pa/ zhabs g.yas cung zad brkyangs shing g.yon bskum pa/ dar dang rin po che'i rgyan gyis brgyan pa gcig tu bsam/ de nas rang gi mdun gyis nam mkha'i gnas su/ paṃ las pad+ma/ raṃ las nyi ma/ ghaṃ las tshogs bdag dkar po gan rkyal du bsgyel ba'i steng du/ hūm̐ dkar po gcig bsam/ de las 'od 'phros/ gdug pa can thams cad tshar bcad/ tshur 'dus pa las/ dpal ye shes kyis mgon po sku mdog dkar po zhal cig phyag drug pa/ zhabs gnyis bzhengs stabs su bzhugs pa/ phyag g.yas kyis dang pos gri gug bar pas thod pa'i phreng ba/ tha mas ḍa ru drag tu 'khrol ba/ g.yon gyi dang pos thod khrag bar pas rtse gsum tha mas rdo rje'i zhags pa bsnams pa/ dmar la zlum pa'i spyan gsum dang ldan pa/ zhal bgrad pa/ mche ba gtsigs pa/ smin ma dang sma ra'i ag tshom brjid pa/ dbu skra dmar ser gyen du brdzes pa/ mi mgo skam po lnga'i dbu rgyan dang / rlon pa khrag 'dzag pa lnga bcu'i do shal can/ rus pa'i rgyan drug dang sbrul gyis brgyan pa/ stag gi spags pa'i sham thabs la dar ljang khu'i ska rags bcings pa/ lto ba 'phyang zhing yan lag rnams sbom la hrags pa/ dpral bar sin+dhu ra byugs shing / phyag dang zhabs rnams la dril bu g.yer khas brgyan pa/ ye shes kyi me 'bar ba'i dbus na bzhugs pa/ mi skyod pa'i dbu rgyan can/ glang po che'i lpags pa rlon pa gos su gyon pa cig bsam/ de'i gnas gsum byin gyis brlabs/ ye shes pa dgug gzhug byas la/ de'i spyi bo'i steng gis mtho gang gi steng du/ pad+ma dang zla ba'i gdan la/ rtsa ba'i bla ma sku mdog dkar po/

zhal cig phyag gnyis pa/ g.yas thod pa'i ḍā ma ru dang / g.yon gser gyis dril bu g.yer kha bsnams pa/ zhabs gnyis bzhengs stabs su bzhugs pa dar dang rin po che'i rgyan sna tshogs kyis brgyan pa/ zhi zhing 'dzum pa'i nyams dang ldan pa/ sku mthong ba tsam gyis sgrib pa 'dag pa/ gsung thos pa tsam gyis phyir mi ldog pa'i sa la 'god nges pa/ 'od zer dpag tu med pa 'phro ba gcig bsgom/ de'i thugs ka nas 'od 'phros pas/ rtsa rgyud kyi bla ma thams cad yi dam thams cad spyan drangs la de la bstim/ bzlas pa byed na mgon po'i thugs ka'i hūm̐ las sngags kyi phreng ba dkar po byung / rang gi zhal du zhugs nas lte bar thim pas nad gdon thams cad bsregs par bsam zhing / ngag tu/ am̐ badz+ra mahā ka la k+ṣiṃ k+ṣe tra big nan bi na ya ka hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa phaṭa swāhā/ ces dang / am̐ badz+ra na ra kriṃ kriṃ hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa phaṭa swā hā/ zhes ci rigs pa bzlas so/ /ma bzlas kyang yan lag ma tshang ba'i nyes pa med do/ /mdor na bla ma dang mgon po dbyer med pa la dad gus drag po byas pas/ bla ma las 'od zer bsam gyi mi khyab pa byung nas/ mgon po la phog pas/ mgon po 'od zer gyis rang bzhin du 'bar/ ḍā ma ru sgra sgrogs/ bla ma dang mgon po dbyer med par bsam/ mgon po las 'od zer bde ba'i rang bzhin dmar la smug pa 'phros nas bla ma la phogs pas/ bla ma bde ba dang 'od kyi rang bzhin du 'bar/ ḍā ma ru dang dril bu'i sgra sgrogs/ mgon po dang bla ma dbyer med du gyur par bsam la/ gsol ba gdab pa ni/ na mo bud dhā ya/ na mo gu ru bh+yaḥ he badz+rawī ra wī ri ṇī/ ḍā ka ḍā ki nī/ /dzo ka dzo ki nī sarba bud+dha bo dhi satwa sha ra ṇa gats+tsha mi/ kyai/ phyogs bcu na bzhugs pa'i rtsa ba brgyud par bcas pa'i dpal ldan bla ma dam pa rnams kyis byin gyis rlobs shig sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa'i tshogs thams cad kyis byin gyis rlobs shig

dpa' bo dang dpa' mo/ /mkha' 'gro dang mkha' 'gro ma rnal 'byor dang rnal 'byor ma'i tshogs thams cad kyis byin gyis rlobs shig dpal ye shes kyi mgon po phyag drug pa'i lha tshogs 'khor dang bcas pa'i ye shes la sgrib pa mi mnga' ba/ mthu nus la thogs pa mi mnga' ba/ thugs rje la phyi bshol mi mnga' ba/ byin rlabs la rgyang ring thung mi mnga' ba khyed rnams kyis sku'i sgo nas byin gyis rlobs shig gsung gi sgo nas byin gyis rlobs shig thugs kyi sgo nas byin gyis rlobs shig sku gsung thugs yon tan 'phrin las dang bcas pa mi bzad pa'i sgo nas byin gyis rlobs shig da lta nyid du/ myur ba nyid du 'dug sa 'di nyid du byin gyis rlobs shig sangs rgyas rdo rje 'chang chen la༞ dpal ldan sha wa ri dbang phyug la༞ mnga' bdag mai tri pa chen po༞ grub chen ra hu la chen po༞ grub thob khrung po rnal 'byor la༞ rmog cog pa rin chen brtson 'grus la༞ dpal ldan skyer sgang pa chen po la༞ chos rje sangs rgyas ston pa la༞ shangs ston tshul khrims 'bum pa la༞ rgyal ba mus pa chen po la༞ mkhas grub rdo rje gzhon nu la༞ mtshan ldan nam mkha'i rnal 'byor la༞ byang sems sbyin pa bzang po la༞ phyag drug ye shes mgon po la༞ bla ma mgon po dbyer med la༞ mgon po bla ma dbyer med la gsol ba 'debs so/ /zhes dang / bla ma mgon po dbyer med༞ bdag la dbang bzhi rdzogs par bskur du gsol/ zhes gsol ba btab pas/ mgon po'i dpral ba nas oṃ dkar po gcig byung / rang gi dpral bar thim/ lus kyi sgribs pa 'dag pa sogs spyi dang mthun/ mgrin pa nas āḥdamar po gcig byung / rang gi mgrin par thim/ thugs ka nas hūm̐ sngon po gcig byung / rang gi snying khar thim/ de nas bla ma mgon po la thim pas mgon po 'od du zhu nas bdag la thim pas/ me long gi gzugs brnyan lta bu la sems mnyam par bzhag lus ngag yid gsum gyis sgrib pa dag

dbang bzhi pa thob snyam du bsam mo/ /de nas/ bla ma mgon po dbyer med la/ /bdag ni gus pas skyabs su mchi/ /bdag dang sems can thams cad kyi/ /nyon mongs ma lus sel bar shog /ces bsngo'o/ /tshigs su bcad pa 'di mthong ngam thos sam/ tha na gser yig tu byas ste mgul du btags na/ mtshams med pa lnga byas pas kyang / 'chi khar zhal mngon gsum du mthong zhing / dag pa'i sa gsum la gnas par 'gyur ro/ /gal srid bar dor mjug dgos srid na yang bar dor mgon po 'di'i rjes su 'dzin no/ /yang na mgon po nag la dkar ba'i mdangs chags par bsgoms kyang rung ngo / /yang gzhan gong dang 'dra ba la/ mdun du pad nyi dang tshogs bdag gi steng du/ mgon po ser nag rgyan cha lugs bzhugs stabs gong 'dra'i spyi bor pad zla'i steng du/ rtsa ba'i bla ma sku mdog gser gtso ma lta bu zhal cig phyag gnyis/ g.yas yid bzhin gyi nor bu dang / g.yon gser gyi dril bu g.yer kha 'dzin pa/ rgyan cha lugs gong dang 'dra ba sgom/ sngar bzhin gsol ba btab pas/ bla ma mgon po la thim/ mgon po bdag la thim pa'i ngang du 'jog bsngo ba gong bzhin bya'o/ /yang mdun du gdan gong gi steng du/ mgon po dmar nag gi spyi bor/ gong 'dra'i gdan gyi steng du/ bla ma sku mdog dmar po/ phyag g.yas ḍā ma ru dang g.yon nor bu 'dzin pa/ rgyan cha lugs gong dang 'dra ba bskyed/ sngar bzhin gsol ba btab dbang zhus/ bsngo ba bya'o/ /yang mdun du gdan gong 'dra'i steng du/ mgon po ljang nag phyag mtshan sogs gong dang 'dra ba sgom/ de'i spyi bor pad zla'i steng du bla ma sku mdog ljang khu g.yas ḍā ma ru dang g.yon 'chi med bdud rtsi'i gang ba'i bum pa bsnams pa cha lugs gong dang 'dra ba sgom/ gong ltar gsol ba btab nas/ dbang zhus/ bsngo ba bya'o/ /yang mdun du chos 'byung nag po'i nang du hūm̐ nag po mgo bo thur du bstan pa cig bsgom hūm̐ zhes brjod pas chos 'byung dang pad+ma nyi ma tshogs bdag gi gdan du gyur/

hūm̐ de mgo bo gyen du log pas/ ye shes kyi mgon po sku mdog char sprin ltar nag pa/ rgyan cha lugs sogs gong dang 'dra ba gcig dang 'khor gnod sbyin bzhi dang / lha mo gzhung bzhin bskyed/ ye shes pa gzhug de'i spyi bor pad nyi'i steng du/ bla ma sku mdog mthing nag zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa khro bo'i cha lugs can/ me dpung gi dbus na bzhugs pa g.yas ḍā ma ru dang / g.yon yid bzhin gyi nor bu rin po che dbang gi rgyal po bsnam pa/ rgyan bzhugs tshul gong dang 'dra ba bsgom la/ sngar bzhin gsol ba btab/ dbang zhus/ bsngo ba bya'o/ /bla ma sku mdog dkar por byas kyang rung ngo / /yang mdun kyi nam mkha'i gnas su pad nyi tshogs bdag dang bcas pa'i steng du/ ye shes mgon po sku mdog sna tshogs pa/ rgyan cha lugs phyag mtshan gong dang 'dra ba bsgom/ de'i spyi bor pad zla la bla ma sku mdog sna tshogs pa/ g.yas ḍa ma ru/ g.yon nor bu rin po che dbang gi rgyal po bsnam pa/ zhi ma khro'i rnam pa can/ rgyan cha lugs gong dang 'dra ba bsgoms/ sngar ltar gsol ba btab/ dbang zhus nas snang ba rang bzhin med pa la blo bzhag rjes su bsngo ba rnam par dag pa bya'o/ /de ltar ma yengs par zla ba bdun bsgom na de nyid du sangs rgya bar byed do/ /tho rangs thun re la bsgom na gzugs sku dang chos sku thob bo/ dbang dang 'brel ba lan cig thob na/ mtshams med pa lnga byas pa yang bar dor sangs mi rgya ba mi srid do/ /'di dag ni sha wa ri pas/ ye shes mgon po'i spyi gtsug tu/ /dbang gi rgyal po bsgoms byas nas/ /'od zer gzi brjid ldan par bsam/ /dbye ba med par gsol btab na/ /sangs rgyas lo zlas 'grub par 'gyur/ /bla ma mgon po dbyer med 'di/ /mi rabs bdun las ma spel shig /ye shes mgon po myur byon nas/ /bdag 'dra sha wa ri pa la/ /lan gsum bar du gsung nas kyang / /bka' rgyas btab nas mkha' la gshegs/

e ma ngo mtshar rmad kyi chos/ /chig brgyud dag las ma spel cig /zhes gsungs pa'i nyams len nying khu'i chos skor gyi yan lag gi chos skor la/ bla ma mgon po dbyer med du sgrub pa'i man ngag 'di yang / lung stong smyon pa rang gi myong ba dang sbyar te/ gnas mchog ri bo cher sbyar ba'o/ /rjes gnang dang man ngag ma thob pa la mi ston no/ ༈ /mgon dkar gyi bstod pa bzhugs so/ ༄༅/ /mgon po yid bzhin nor bu la phyag 'tshal lo/ phyogs bcu dus gsum sangs rgyas thams cad kyi/ /thugs rje gcig bsdus rje btsun spyan ras gzigs/ /de yi sprul pa phyag drug mgon po la/ /lus ngag yid gsum dang bas phyag 'tshal lo/ /bcom ldan yid bzhin nor bu thugs rje can/ /sku mdog gangs ri lta bur 'od zer 'phro/ /zhal cig phyag drug zhabs gnyis nor bdag mnan/ /'gro ba'i dbul ba sel la phyag 'tshal lo/ /phyag g.yas dang po rdo rje gri gug bsnams/ /bar pas yid bzhin nor bus dgos 'dod ster/ /tha ma ḍā rus mkha' 'gro dbang du sdud/ /khams gsum dbang du sdud la phyag 'tshal lo/ /g.yon pa rin chen bum pa sku la rten/ /bar pa rtse gsum khams gsum ma lus sgrol /tha ma lcags kyus ngan song gnas nas 'dren/ /mgon po thugs rje can la phyag 'tshal lo/ /sku stod rin chen rgyan gyis rnam par brgyan/ /sku smad rin chen zar bus rnam par mdzes/ /phyag zhabs thams cad rin chen nor bus brgyan/ /'gro ba'i re 'dod skong la phyag 'tshal lo/ /khyod ni yid la dran pa tsam gyis kyang / /de yi mod la dbul phongs sdug bsngal sel/ /'gro ba'i re 'dod tshul bzhin skong mdzad pa'i/ /yid bzhin nor bu khyod la bdag bstod do/ /mgon po khyod la mchod cing gus btud nas/ /ji srid byang chub ma thob bar du yang / /mgon po khyod kyi thugs rjes rab bzung nas/ /byang chub sgrub pa'i mthun rkyen sgrub par mdzod/ /de yi dge bas bdag kyang khyed bzhin du/

/'gro ba'i re 'dod tshul bzhin bskong ba dang / /sems can sangs rgyas sa la 'god pa yi/ /'gro ba'i don la mthu dang ldan par mdzod/ /mgon po yid bzhin nor bu la bstod pa dgos 'dod kun 'byung mkhas grub khyung po rnal 'byor gyis mdzad pa'o zhes bya ba rdzogs so// //sarba maṅga laṃ/ bkra shis par gyur cig/ //dge'o// // PAGE \* MERGEFORMAT 6 tshar chen blo gsal rgya mtsho/ khyung po rnal 'byor pas mdzad pa'i bla ma mgon po dbyer med kyi sgrub thabs/ PAGE \* MERGEFORMAT 7
